data.content_ref: inline:Dependence: the soundness of the defended trial (SRC_011) depends on SRC_014's two-level warrant validity, because the trial's sustaining case is only sound when its defending warrant nodes are accepted in the inner grounded pass; the trial verdict inherits the inner labelling's acceptance. Refuted if the defending warrants are attacked by arguments accepted only in the outer labelling, so the inner pass is blind to the trial's actual defense and the soundness claim fails.
